metadata.dcterms:title: HAROLD WIDOM’S WORK IN RANDOM MATRIX THEORY
metadata.dcterms:creator: CORWIN, IVAN Z.
DEIFT, PERCY A.
ITS, ALEXANDER R.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: This is a survey of Harold Widom’s work in random matrices. We start with his pioneering papers on the sine-kernel determinant, continue with his and Craig Tracy’s groundbreaking results concerning the distribution functions of random matrix theory, touch on the remarkable universality of the Tracy-Widom distributions in mathematics and physics, and close with Tracy and Widom’s remarkable work on the asymmetric simple exclusion pro- cess.
